methods.what: Conversion of clock time to true Göttingen time and true Paris time using clock readings at true noon on consecutive days, then interpolation of solar RA and declination from the Connaissance des tems
methods.quote: Hieraus findet sich für obige Zeitmomente aus der Connaissance des tems

methods.what: Refraction constant: log of mean refraction value corrected for barometer and thermometer
Solar horizontal parallax: mean parallax corrected by log of Sun-Earth distance
methods.quote:

methods.what: Auxiliary angle theta from tan(phi) and cos(h) (log tang phi + log cos h)
Refraction in right ascension computed logarithmically as rho·cos theta·tan h/(cos delta·cos(theta−delta))
Refraction in declination computed as rho·tan(theta−delta)
Parallax in right ascension computed as pi·cos phi·sin h/cos delta
Parallax in declination computed as pi·sin phi·sin(theta−delta)/sin theta
Apparent RA and declination obtained by adding refraction and parallax corrections to the true values
